units: <cite ref="Taanit 4a:1">Taan. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ דתותי קלא</he> the kernel under a clod.

<cite ref="Taanit 4a:1-2">Ib.</cite> <he>האי צורבא לפ׳ וכ׳ …</he> a young scholar is like the kernel &c. (v. <cite ref="N00066"><he>נְבַט</he></cite>), i.e. when his reputation begins to spread, it spreads wider and wider.—Pl. <he>פַּרְצִידַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q01979"><he>פַּרְצִידֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:7">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ דרומנא וכ׳</he> the seeds of a red pomegranate.
<cite ref="Shabbat 21a:3">Sabb. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מפַּרְצִידוֹהִי וכ׳</he> from its kernels they produce oil.
